stats.player_note: Players are the participants of the observed plays each simulated play was sampled from. They are not this game's roster or lineup, and these lines are not evidence about those players.

clock_start_stop.guard: the record carries observed snap-to-snap runoff, clock state, stoppage reasons and restart triggers; restart-trigger semantics are a modeled approximation

timeouts.guard: observed timeouts decrement the named team within its three-per-half allowance and are recorded as clock stops; an unavailable caller or exhausted allowance blocks the game

penalties.guard: no penalty is drawn: E1 excludes penalty plays from its pool (classify: penalty, not modelled)
penalties.enforced_by: E1 pool exclusion, counted in the pool exclusions

onside_kicks.guard: every kickoff is drawn from the observed kickoff pool; no onside kick is drawn

overtime.guard: a regulation tie with no observed overtime table is blocked as overtime_not_modelled; with the table, overtime drives are observed and Rule 16 decides the winner
overtime.enforced_by: record status and the scope reason

lineups.guard: participants are labelled sampled_observed_play; no lineup or substitution is modelled

missed_field_goal_return.guard: Rule 11-4-2 exceptions (1) and (2): the receiving start spot is sampled from observed next-drive transitions after missed field goals; a returner, return touchdown and physical return are not reconstructed

safety_free_kick.guard: a safety free kick is drawn only from the observed 2022-2025 safety-kick table (receiving spot and clock; a kick with no receiving snap before the quarter ends is excluded). Without that table, or at a Q1/Q3 end with no clock left, the game blocks; the ordinary kickoff pool is never used
safety_free_kick.enforced_by: safety-kick source label in validate_game; record blocker when the table is absent

blocked_kicks.guard: blocked-kick rates and transitions are sampled from the pinned 2022-2025 nflverse fixture; a sampled penalty, fumble, review, missing recovery, or unresolved endpoint blocks the game

gaps: field-goal, blocked field-goal and blocked punt outcomes are sampled from published 2022-2025 nflverse rates; the block rates are rare and carry wide confidence intervals, and unresolved sampled transitions block the game
blocked-kick returns are recorded in team totals; individual returner statistics are not assigned to the frozen roster
field-goal and try outcomes are drawn from the published nfl_pbp rates (2022-2025, weeks 1-18): each draw is a labelled sample, not the result of a real game
missed-field-goal next-drive spots are sampled from observed transitions; returners and return touchdowns are not reconstructed
safety free kicks are sampled from the observed 2022-2025 safety-kick table (spot and clock only); a safety at a Q1/Q3 end with no clock left still blocks

penalties, onside kicks and exception coin-toss paths remain capability limitations; overtime is modelled for the regular-season period only (Rule 16: 10 minutes, the toss winner receives, the two-minute warning and Article 5(a) are not modelled); a game that takes an unsupported path is blocked or marked incomplete
clock transitions use observed snap-to-snap runoff and explicit stoppages/restart triggers; restart-trigger semantics are an approximation and should be checked against the applicable season rulebook

offense participants are sampled by role and depth rank from each team's frozen pregame depth chart; this is a statistical assignment and does not construct all 22 players, defensive personnel or substitutions

provisional_rules.label: provisional_practice_rule
provisional_rules.applies_to: a touchdown, made field goal or safety whose clock expires in Q1 or Q3
provisional_rules.effect: the scoring side (or the conceding side, after a safety) kicks off at the start of the next quarter
provisional_rules.source: NFL practice, not written in docs/rules/NFL-2026-GAME-STATE-RULES.md. Confirm against the 2026 rulebook before it is read as a rules-file fact.

provisional_rules.label: provisional_practice_rule
provisional_rules.applies_to: a score whose clock expires in Q2
provisional_rules.effect: no post-score kickoff; the second-half kickoff from the ledger follows
provisional_rules.source: NFL practice, not written in docs/rules/NFL-2026-GAME-STATE-RULES.md. Confirm against the 2026 rulebook before it is read as a rules-file fact.

provisional_rules.label: authored_modelling_choice
provisional_rules.applies_to: a kickoff whose runoff exhausts the clock
provisional_rules.effect: the quarter ends on the return; the receiver starts the next quarter at the kick spot
provisional_rules.source: authored modelling choice, matching E1 clamping a play runoff at 0:00; not in the rules file
